Kojima Productions Announces Death Stranding: Isolations Anime Series for 2027

Expanding the Death Stranding Universe

Kojima Productions has officially confirmed the development of *Death Stranding: Isolations*, an original animated series set within the universe of the *Death Stranding* video game franchise. The announcement, released via official social media channels, confirms that the series is scheduled to debut exclusively on Disney+ in 2027.

First Look and Creative Direction

A brief teaser trailer has been released to accompany the announcement. The footage introduces a young protagonist experiencing recurring, unsettling dreams involving tar, accompanied by the haunting tagline: "My mom became a crater." Kojima Productions notes that the series will feature a unique ensemble of characters, implying that the narrative will likely branch away from the core cast of the original games.

Key creative personnel include:

  • Director: Takayuki Sano, known for his work on *Attack on Titan* and *Jujutsu Kaisen*.
  • Screenplay/Composition: Tow Ubukata, a science-fiction writer recognized for his contributions to the *Psycho-Pass* series and *Ghost in the Shell: The New Movie*.
  • Animation Studio: E&H production, the studio behind *Ninja Kamui* and the upcoming *Magic Knight Rayearth* reboot.

Industry Context

This project marks a significant expansion for Kojima Productions as it moves into episodic animation. The studio has recently been active in several high-profile collaborations, including the upcoming horror title *OD* (developed with Jordan Peele) and the newly announced espionage project, *Physint*.

How to Verify

As of now, the primary details regarding the project are sourced from the official Kojima Productions social media announcements. To monitor future updates regarding the release schedule or further casting, audiences are encouraged to follow the official Kojima Productions social media accounts or the Disney+ press newsroom. No specific month or day has been finalized for the 2027 release window.
